narrative:
Guernsey County has 23,730 registered voters, with 15.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.6%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 21.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.3% of registrants.
